node.statement: A finite-dimensional C*-algebra is *-isometrically a finite direct sum of full matrix algebras: split its center by minimal central projections, and in each resulting simple summand use a minimal projection and the polar parts of nonzero minimal left-ideal maps to obtain matrix units, which identify that summand with M_q. For M_q, let S,T be the shift and clock unitaries and W_ab=S^a T^b. Direct verification on matrix units gives D_q=q^(-2) sum_(a,b) W_ab^dagger tensor W_ab, with X D_q=D_q X, pi(D_q)=I, and every tensor summand a positive weight times U^dagger tensor U.
